annotations.title: Preview the signing page or email

description: Render markdown exactly as a recipient will see it: the signing page (default) or the signature-request email. Returns HTML you can show your human, plus validation results. Free, no account needed. Once the document is saved as a draft, prefer its preview_url, which your human can open in a browser and use to compare styles.

message.description: Optional note from the sender shown in the email.

view.description: Which view to render. Defaults to signing_page.
